_source: Output of harness/lumber_opt.plan_from_store at git ee59524 (extracted to scratch), run READ-ONLY on the frozen DB copy harness_20261006_1200.db (opened mode=ro, copied to an in-memory DB via the backup API, rows with t >= CUT dropped from the copy), world=None i.e. no live character, route_check=False, seed=1, now=CUT=1791306000 (2026-10-06 12:00 CDT), over the full store (86 lumber trip rows). 132 spots (127 active, 5 disabled; 123 eligible at this moment), 37 with at least one trip (25 single-trip, 23 with field time > 0.00 h). P(best) per spot from 2000 Thompson draws. rate_logs_h = posterior mean field rate (Gamma, quasi-Poisson dispersion phi, recency half-life 14 d, skill-rescaled to now); rate_80 = 80% interval; net_logs_h = renewal-reward net stored logs/h at Q*; deaths/sent_home/thefts per field hour are Gamma posteriors shrunk to pooled rates. Unvisited spots all share the empirical-Bayes prior (3166 logs/h, CV 0.35). Pick at this snapshot: witcher_244 (explore, P(best)=0.009); greedy best witcher_23.
